style.backgroundSystem: high-key morning-light set: pale plaster wall #F1EFEB with soft foliage leaf-shadow, pale stone or marble shelf #EDEAE4 carrying one real reflection; infographic screens switch to a flat warm paper field #F7F6F3 with thin stone slab edge #E4E2DD; scene and detail blocks sit on a saturated azure field #2E86E8 with champagne panels #E8D5B6
style.direction: bright daylight brushed-metal electricals commerce, airy product-on-stone hero plus flat light paper infographic fields
style.iconSystem: two-tone thin line icons, azure #2E86E8 plus champagne #C7A97B stroke, 1.5pt, flat, no fill, no shield or seal silhouettes that could read as a certification mark
style.lightingSystem: warm directional daylight key from upper left around 4800-5200K with raking grazing light that reads the brushed grain direction, cool sky fill from the right, one long soft leaf-dappled shadow in the same direction on every shot, a single controlled specular streak across the brushed face, never blown to a mirror and never flattened
style.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent bright daylight brushed-metal building-electricals ecommerce visual system across the entire image set; fixed page palette of mineral off-white #F7F6F3, misted stone grey #E4E2DD, charcoal text #3A3B3D and one azure accent #2E86E8, with champagne #C7A97B and #E8D5B6 read only as the product's own brushed face finish and its tinted copy panels, never as page colours to restyle; warm-neutral high-key lighting, single directional daylight-weighted key from upper left around 5000K with raking grazing light that reads the brushed grain, cool sky fill from the right, one matched soft shadow direction and one controlled specular streak on the brushed face; modern geometric sans-serif with every Chinese line wrapped in 「」 and kept as a short placeholder; high-key plaster-and-pale-stone product stage with a leaf-dappled wall, flat warm paper fields for infographics, and an azure #2E86E8 field with champagne #E8D5B6 panels for detail and scene blocks; two-tone thin line icons at 1.5pt stroke; stable upright square-on plate geometry with rocker count, bezel width, corner radius, indicator sliver and terminal layout exactly as in the reference; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles, no invented certification marks, no fabricated numeric ratings or lifetime claims, no exposed live wiring, no metal reinterpretation of the plate face, no warped straight lines.
noDrift: no inconsistent lighting or shadow direction
no invented certification marks, 3C or CE style seals, compliance logos or test-report artwork
no invented current, voltage or load rating, no amperage or wattage value anywhere
no invented fire-retardant grade, temperature figure, lifetime or press-count claim
no invented model code, series name or brand field
no QR code, membership badge or store stamp
no solid cast-metal reinterpretation of the plate - the brushed finish stays a brushed face finish, no added metal machining marks, screws or seams
no plastic face rendered as glossy chrome, no metal face rendered as matte plastic
no exposed live wiring, no hand touching terminals, no installation shown with power on
no invented glowing LED interface or text on the plate face
style.presentationRules: plate always square and upright whenever the face is the subject, vertical and horizontal edges never warped; brushed grain direction consistent within one plate; rocker count, rocker proportions, bezel width, corner radius, indicator sliver position and terminal layout exactly as supplied in the reference; identical plate scale across a card row
style.surfaceSystem: honed pale limestone / marble shelf edge #EDEAE4 over a smooth plaster floor #F1EFEB; no wet look, no dark studio floor
style.typography: one modern geometric Chinese sans-serif family; Chinese in-image copy wrapped in 「」 as short placeholders, headline 28-44pt, subtitle 16-20pt, label 10-14pt, airy leading, no dense body text
